title: Message Relay Phones
description: Explains which parts of the phone network fail and why texts get through when calls don't, then how to set up an out-of-area contact. Covers internet, radio, and physical message methods, Red Cross Safe and Well and FEMA apps, and a short message format.
shortDescription: Texts over calls, out-of-area contacts, and Red Cross Safe and Well
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
